name: proto-blocks/oit-navigation
title: OIT Main Navigation
description: Main site navigation: logo, WP nav menu with dropdowns, CTA, mobile drawer with phone and social links.

menuLocation.label: WP Menu Location
menuLocation.help: Theme-registered nav menu location slug. Register with register_nav_menus() in the theme.

showViewAll.label: Show "View All" link in dropdowns
showViewAll.help: Adds a "View All" link at the bottom of each dropdown that points to the parent menu item's URL.

phoneNumber.label: Phone Number
phoneNumber.help: Shown in the desktop phone bar above the nav and in the mobile menu. Example: 888.308.6689

supportText.label: Support Label
supportText.help: Text shown before the phone number in the desktop phone bar (e.g. "Get Support:"). Leave blank to show the number only.

showPhoneBar.label: Show Phone Bar Above Nav (desktop)
showPhoneBar.help: Adds a slim bar above the nav on desktop with the handset icon + Phone Number. Mobile keeps the phone in the slide-out menu.

phoneBarTheme.label: Phone Bar Color
phoneBarTheme.help: Auto = white text on the homepage (dark hero) and dark text on standard white pages. Override if a landing page also uses a dark background.

showSocial.label: Show Social Icons in Mobile Menu

showSocialBar.label: Show Social Icons in Phone Bar (desktop)
showSocialBar.help: Adds the social icons to the left side of the desktop bar above the nav. Uses the Social URLs above.
